text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Misato is on patrol around the forest as part of her guild duties.
text_block_list.orig_text: ミサトは、ギルドの仕事で森の見回りをしていた。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Hm...
I'd heard reports of monsters lurking around these parts,
but nothing seems out of the ordinary to me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
んー……
最近このあたりで、
魔物ちゃんを見た子が
いるっていうから見に来たけど……
特に異常はなさそうね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
This is a popular spot for the children, though.
I'd rather not let even the slightest thing slip by.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここでよく遊んでる子もいるし、
先生心配だわぁ……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Oh my!
Someone's collapsed over there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……あら？
あらあら大変！　
誰か倒れてるわ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Are you okay?
What happened here?
Don't worry. You can confide in me.
choice_data_list: I took a big bite of a mushroom.
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫ー？
どうしたのかな？　
先生に言ってごらん。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Paralyzed, you say? Oh my.
Did you eat anything strange, perhaps?
text_block_list.orig_text:
痺れて？　
あらあらあら、
もしかして
なにか食べちゃったのかしら。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
A mushroom? Oh my.
That might just be the reason.
text_block_list.orig_text:
キノコ？　
あらあら、
もしかしたらそれが原因で
体が痺れてるのかもしれないわ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
It must have been a poisonous mushroom.
Surely its appearance should have been a warning sign?
choice_data_list: Tell that to my empty stomach.
text_block_list.orig_text:
きっと毒キノコね……
見た目からして凄かったでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Poor little thing.
Let me heal you right up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
かわいそうに、
すぐに毒を消してあげますからね～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Stay still for me, I'll make it qui—
text_block_list.orig_text:
すこーしだけ
じっとしてて──

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRRRAAAAGGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! You certainly popped out of nowhere, didn't you?
You gave me a big old fright.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら！　
魔物ちゃんったらいつの間に……
先生、びっくりしちゃったわ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Be a good boy and wait here for me, okay?
I'll have a little chat with our friend over there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんね。
ちょっとだけいい子で待っててね。
魔物ちゃんとお話ししてくるわ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Good day.
You must be the friendly little monster
roaming around here lately.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんにちは。
君がこのあたりをウロウロしていた魔物ちゃんね～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
I'm terribly sorry, but you've been scaring the children.
Would you mind if I asked you to—
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんなさいね。
子供たちも怖がってしまうからおうちに──

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my. You're in no state to be leaping onto the front line.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら、
そんな状態で前に出たら危ないわよ。

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAAAGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Now now, my little friend.
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物ちゃんも
大丈夫よ～

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAAAAGGGHHHH
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Oh my! Are you okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら！　
大丈夫～？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, my little friend.
You must have been so startled.
There, there. Who's a good little monster?
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物ちゃんも急に驚いたわよね。
ごめんなさいね。
ほーら、
いい子いい子……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Grrr...
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオ……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry.
There's nothing to be afraid of.
text_block_list.orig_text:
怖くないわよ。
誰も君をいじめたりしないからね……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
It's about time you go back home.
I'm sure your parents are worried sick about you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おうちに帰りましょうね。
お母さんや
お父さんも、きっと心配してるわ。

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: *whine*
text_block_list.orig_text: ──クゥーン……クゥーン……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Phew... I'm glad it was a well-behaved monster.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ……
聞き分けの良い子で助かったわ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Oh my. You went and got yourself hurt.
That's what happens when you push yourself too much.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら、
怪我しちゃってるわね。
痺れた体で無理しちゃ駄目よ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
So you were trying to protect me?
How kind of you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
守ってくれようとしたの？
とっても優しい子なのね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
I must say, that makes me quite happy.
Thank you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
先生嬉しいわ～
ありがとう……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
What a brave little soul you are.
There, there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
勇気のある子ね。
いい子いい子、
よしよし。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Pain, pain, go away! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
痛いの痛いの、
飛んでけー♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. How do you feel?
That should have taken care of both the poison and your wounds.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふふ、
どうかしら。
これでもう毒も怪我も大丈夫よ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Yes. You seem fine enough.
I really am quite surprised, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……うん、
もう平気。
それにしても不思議だわ～

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
That mushroom you ate is rather well-known
all over the continent. Even if its appearance didn't
put you off, I'd expect you to be aware of it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
あの毒キノコ、
見た目も凄いけど
大陸ではかなり有名だから、
食べる人は滅多にいないのよ……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Even monsters do their best to stay away from it,
which makes it all the more surprising.
choice_data_list: Being an amnesiac probably doesn't help.
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物ちゃんも食べないくらいなんだけど……
あなたは知らなかったの？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, oh my!
Now it all makes sense.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあらあら！
それなら知らなくても無理ないわね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
You poor little thing.
I'm sure you've been through a lot...
text_block_list.orig_text:
今まできっと苦労したでしょうに……
大変だったわね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
That said.
It takes quite the mental fortitude to pick up a
mushroom straight from the ground and eat it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
とはいえ、
お腹が空いたからって
地面に生えてる毒キノコを
ぱくっと食べちゃうのは凄いわね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Usually it's only children that
throw anything and everything into their mouths...
text_block_list.orig_text:
まるでなんでもお口に入れちゃう
子供みたい……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Oh my.
I just had a wonderful idea. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら、
そうだわ～
先生良いこと思いついちゃった♪

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
There's a nursery in the elven village, you see.
And I just so happen to be a teacher there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
実は私ね、
エルフの里で保育園の先生をしてるの。
それでね、
あなたさえよければなんだけど……

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
So my question is...
Would you be willing to let me become your teacher?
text_block_list.orig_text:
私に
あなたの先生をさせてもらえないかしら～？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
I'd rather avoid you eating another poisonous mushroom.
Plus, I can teach you all sorts of other useful things.
text_block_list.orig_text:
また毒キノコを食べちゃったりしたら大変だし……
なにより色々教えてあげられると思うのよ。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
This is just a suggestion, of course.
There's no need to feel pressured.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろん、嫌なら無理強いはしないわ。
……どうかしら？

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Good to hear it.
I look forward to teaching you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あらあら、
よかったわ～
こちらこそよろしくね。

text_block_list.name: Misato
text_block_list.text: Please call me Miss Misato. ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
私のことは、
ミサト先生って呼んでね♪

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
And thus {0} became
one of Misato's lovely students.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミサトが世話をする子供たちの中に、
{0}も加わるのだった。
